title: IELTS Semantic World
sourceBasis: The three original IELTS vocabulary files and Master Lexicon V1.2 remain separate from this prototype. SRC/BRG terms trace back to source-derived records; EXP/COL terms cite external evidence; scene narratives, prompts, and word-by-word contextual Chinese glosses are researcher inference. WordNet 3.0 dictionary senses/examples are an independent licensed external evidence layer, while scene sense matching and contrast examples are researcher inference.
